description: Baseline: terrain art fills left 75%, plain text sidebar with Mode/Terrain/Levels/Seed/Keys. No colour, no visual hierarchy in sidebar. Monochrome.
Sectioned sidebar: MODE/TERRAIN/PARAMS/KEYS with icons, horizontal separators, terrain-specific icons in header. Better structure but still monochrome.
ANSI colour sidebar: cyan section headers, red CHAOS mode, yellow key shortcuts, gray separators and labels, white values. Direct setContent bypasses wrapIndentedText. Aesthetic jumped from 4 to 7.
